{{Quote|'Religious order'? Ha-ha-ha! Oh, I like him. He's so bright!|Koobaree, after meeting Han Solo|<ref name="TPE" />}}
'''Koobaree''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Five]], a reclusive evil-worshipping cult that lived within a remote section of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known as the [[Hellhoop/Legends|Hellhoop]]. Koobaree and her compatriots spent [[Standard year/Legends|centuries]] [[Torture/Legends|torturing]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] unfortunate travelers&mdash;notably, they captured and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] [[Wutzek]], the last known living [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Demon/Legends|demon]]. Sometime between [[0 ABY/Legends|0]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the Five captured [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leaders [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], planning to kill the two Humans the same way they had so many others. However, their [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] friend [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] managed to free Wutzek, who killed Koobaree and all other members of the Five.<ref name="TPE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Koobaree appeared in ''[[The Pandora Effect]]'', a [[1981]] comic story written by [[Alan Moore]] and published in [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 151]]. In the story, Koobaree was drawn by [[Adolfo Buylla]].<ref name="TPE" />
